455:t_2:67.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Then $$ミコノ$$ is confronting $$ミカゲ$$ right now?」

455:t_2:68.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Going by what old man $$不動$$ said, that's how it is.」

455:t_2:69.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Why did you get warped into this space, $$カグラ$$...?」

455:t_2:70.en:
$$カグラ$$
「The old man told me to go pick you up.」

455:t_2:72.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That old man... jerking people around however he likes... Does he think I'm his pet or something?」

455:t_2:73.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah... I kind of get it.」

455:t_2:74.en:
$$カグラ$$
「This is no time to be grinning! She's up against $$ミカゲ$$, of all people!」

455:t_2:75.en:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミコノ$$ is in trouble right about now, I'm sure of it!」

455:t_2:78.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...I can hear $$ミコノ$$'s voice...」

455:t_2:79.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But it's strange... It's like there are two $$ミコノ$$s...」

455:t_2:80.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That must be $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_2:81.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シルヴィア$$, you mean... $$ミコノ$$'s past life...!」

455:t_2:82.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah, that's right. Old man $$不動$$ said he'd summon her to settle everything.」

455:t_2:83.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If she's here with $$ミコノ$$, then that guy's got to be here too.」

455:t_2:85.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah. Our past life... $$アポロ$$.」

455:t_2:87.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But what do we do...? The $$神話型アクエリオン$$ is in $$ミカゲ$$'s hands...」

455:t_2:88.en:
$$カグラ$$
「As long as he has it, hatred gets amplified and we don't stand a chance...」

455:t_2:91.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The $$神話型アクエリオン$$ shows its power when three forces become one...」

455:t_2:92.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The one who built it was $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the $$天翅$$ of Slaughter... And the past life of $$アポロ$$, who is our past life, was his pet, the winged dog $$ポロン$$...」

455:t_2:93.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So I'm sure $$アクエリオン$$ will answer our cries.」

455:t_2:94.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You, me, and $$アポロ$$... Three forces, huh.」

455:t_2:95.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Right! Now is the time to take the light that fell into darkness... the sun... into our hands!」

455:t_2:97.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah, there's no other way! With the power of the three of us, we'll take back the sun!!」

455:t_2:102.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll burn you to ash! You hateful woman who took my beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ from me!」

455:t_2:104.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry... I've been looking away this whole time...」

455:t_2:105.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「From the sin of taking the one you loved from you... and from your sorrow...!」

455:t_2:108.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I'll connect them...! I'll connect the souls that love and sorrow tore apart, I promise!」

455:t_2:112.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Are you saying you accept it!? That the one loved by $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, whom we both loved, will be joined with a little winged dog in the next life!」

455:t_2:113.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(The loser in love can only leave... That is true of me and $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ alike.)

455:t_2:114.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(But there is no need to drown in sorrow or be stained by hatred. Let us love the one whom our beloved loves.)

455:t_2:115.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Filthy! Wingless love, of all things!」

455:t_2:117.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Humans and $$天翅$$s are no different! Everyone has a heart that loves!」

455:t_2:118.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(Yes... And the cry of that love crosses even dimensions.)

455:t_2:120.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A dog's cry...!? No, that's not it!」

455:t_2:122.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「A cry from the soul, like $$アポロ$$'s... But it's not $$アポロ$$...!」

455:t_2:123.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「So that's the one you loved, $$ミコノ$$.」

455:t_2:126.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I can hear it much more clearly this time!」

455:t_2:127.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$アポロ$$! This is no time for you to be asleep, either!」

455:t_2:129.en:
$$シリウス$$
(Heh... So the sun rises again from the depths of the earth...)

455:t_2:132.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(This is the power of those who love each other.)

455:t_3:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

455:t_3:7.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「What is with this guy...!?」

455:t_3:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...She smells a little different from $$シルヴィア$$ after all. How do I put it... kind of... oddly wimpy...」

455:t_3:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Same here. She doesn't have $$ミコノ$$'s soft, sweet smell, and she's more... you know... ravenous...」

455:t_3:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You two... sniffing a girl all over without her consent is kind of a bad idea, I think.」

455:t_3:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you talking about? Checking out a newcomer's background is only natural.」

455:t_3:14.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You're a newcomer among us too, you know...」
